newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning, fueled by Dow.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning, fueled by Dow.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early morning Tuesday trade, fueled by the Dow industrials' strong rebound overnight, brokers said.
They said that investor interest was still focused on global issues.
As of 0013 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 132.27 points or 0.63 percent at 20,735.98. Its December futures were 80 points higher at 20,750.
"Tokyo is being encouraged by the renewed strength of Wall Street and buying of blue-chip issues is leading the market today," Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities, said.
